case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO 5373 OF 2019; CIVIL APPEAL NO 6715 OF 2019

parties.petitioner: Hewlett Packard India Sales Pvt. Ltd.; Lenevo (India) Pvt. Ltd.

summary: Correct classification of All-in-One Desktop Computers under tariff headings 8471 30 10 (portable) vs 8471 50 00; dispute over 'portability' despite weight <10kg; considerations: external power requirement, non-foldable structure, 18.5+ inch display, fixed vertical usage; CESTAT confirmed portability based on weight alone; court examined legislative intent, dictionary vs technical meaning of 'portable'; key distinction: whether device requires external tethering or can function independently as laptops do; final determination required on whether goods belong under portable data machines or processing units category.
legal_provisions_cited: Central Excise Tariff Act, 1985 First Schedule
Mathuram Agrawal v State of MP (1999) 8 SCC 667
final_judgment: Text appears to be truncated before final judgment section; based on available text no conclusive final order is stated - case likely remanded for further consideration on portability definition specific to ADP machines rather than general dictionary meaning.
